response.sql:
WITH player_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM manager_award
    GROUP BY player_id
),
counts_with_total AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           award_count,
           SUM(award_count) OVER () AS total_awards
    FROM player_counts
)
SELECT player_id,
       award_count,
       CAST(award_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(total_awards, 0) AS fraction
FROM counts_with_total
ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Players with no manager_award records are excluded because the request counts manager_award records per player; the total is the sum of counts for players represented in that table.
